value: Automotive Mechanical and Electrical Repair and Maintenance

This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in providing (1) a wide range of mechanical and electrical repair and maintenance services for automotive vehicles, such as passenger cars, trucks, and vans, and all trailers or (2) engine repair and replacement.
Automotive engine repair and replacement shops
Automotive fleet repair and maintenance services
Automotive repair and replacement shops, general
Engine repair and replacement shops, automotive
Garages, general automotive repair (except gasoline service stations)
Mobile automotive and truck repair services
